title: Scalar-unit normalized strong monoidal extension of internal scalars
statement: Let C be a symmetric monoidal category with coequalizers, with tensoring on either side preserving colimits of small diagrams. Let R,S be commutative monoid objects and φ:R→S a monoid morphism. Use E=Ext_φ, Res_φ and the scalar unit u of [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars], and the relative tensors of [def-sfb-modobj-symmetric-tensor]. There exists a strong monoidal structure m on E such that for every R-module M,N, the underlying comonoidal tensor map satisfies q(M,N);u(M tensor_R N);δ_m(M,N) = (u(M) tensor u(N));q(E M,E N). Here q is the relative tensor coequalizer projection and semicolons denote composition in the displayed order.

source.place: lemma-tensor-product-pullback, balanced tensor universal property and change of rings; sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product.

proof.text: The S-balanced projection q(M,N) is R-balanced after restriction. Descend it to Res M tensor_R Res N → Res(M tensor_S N), with unit R→Res S equal to φ. Check linearity, naturality, associativity and both unitalities after the relative tensor projections, using ambient coherence and braiding naturality. This defines a lax monoidal restriction functor.

source.place: lemma-tensor-product-pullback, balanced tensor universal property and change of rings; sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product.

proof.text: Equip its left adjoint E with the canonical oplax monoidal structure. The adjunction Hom equivalence is the explicit extension equivalence, whose unit is u. Its defining tensor adjunct is (u M tensor_R u N) followed by the restriction tensor map. Precomposition with q gives precisely the required normalization.

source.place: lemma-tensor-product-pullback, balanced tensor universal property and change of rings; sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product.

proof.text: Construct an isomorphism E M tensor_S E N ≅ E(M tensor_R N): first cancel the middle S using the bimodule associator and restricted right unitor; identify the restricted symmetric bimodule of E M with the extension bimodule by symmetry and the action laws; reassociate to S tensor_R (M tensor_R N). The regular bimodule right unitor also gives E R ≅ S. Their projection formulas show that the first map carries u M tensor u N to u(M tensor_R N), and the unit map carries u R to φ.

source.place: lemma-tensor-product-pullback, balanced tensor universal property and change of rings; sites-cohomology.tex, Tag 07A4, lemma-pullback-tensor-product.

proof.text: Compose the canonical oplax tensor map with this concrete inverse. Under the extension adjunction its composite with u is the identity after q, by the projection formula. Cancel the epimorphism q and use injectivity of the adjunction to get the identity. Thus the canonical tensor map is the inverse isomorphism. The same adjunct computation identifies the oplax unit map with E R ≅ S. An oplax monoidal functor with invertible unit and tensor maps is strong monoidal; the inherited tensor map satisfies the normalization already proved.
